full_details: You were at the desk until the reckoning. At dinner the loaf was a penny and a full thumb short, and you left the pages upstairs. At the Theatre Sam said the name to your face in simple good faith, taking it for a title, like Cavaliero. Pell brought it in from the twopenny rooms. The sweet one, she had said, is the one that looks sour. You told Kemp he had you by heart in two days, and that Cambridge had needed a book. He was first on the Queen's paper. You mean to be comfortable there. Pope said he was equally wronged. Garnish would not write the name, wrote it, and scraped the pasteboard until the word was gone. The boxes were a shilling out. Larkham found a hurried change between Pell's box and the stair, not a thief, and he had Heminges enter the correction on the line, not at the foot. Cowley held the candle. The share was twenty-nine shillings. Kemp told yours out with a flourish and the name. It will be daily now. Under it, heard by everyone but Kemp, a play is going up in twelve days with no fool in it. At home you set twenty-nine beside last Saturday's thirty-three. You did not open the coffer. It stands as ruled, at twenty pound fifteen.
one_sentence: The name stuck in the tiring-house, Garnish scraped it off the plot, and the share was twenty-nine shillings once Larkham found the shilling.
title: The name stuck, and the share was twenty-nine
